title: Tesla FSD ‘subscriptions’ hit 1.74M, counted the way Musk’s pay package wants
snippet: Tesla says it now has 1.74 million active “Full Self-Driving” subscriptions, up 67% from a year ago. A footnote in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter explains how it gets there: the metric follows “our 2025 CEO Performance Award” and “includes both upfront payment and monthly subscriptions.” So owners who bought FSD outright, some of them years ago, count as subscribers.
